source.enrichment: web search (japan-guide, snowjapan.com, official resort sites, wikipedia)

schema_note: Top-level shape adapted from niseko/resorts.json. Niseko itself is not duplicated here — see ../niseko/ for the detailed multi-file Niseko bundle. Each resort entry adds name_zh and description_zh fields because the curating source is Traditional Chinese; the English notes condense the Chinese marketing text. Coordinates are best-effort: explicit search hits where available, otherwise known reference points (±100 m).

resorts.name: Rusutsu Resort
resorts.description_zh: 位於日本北海道羊蹄山山麓的留壽都滑雪場Rusutsu，飯店包含了RUSUTSU RESORT以及24層樓高的RUSUTSU TOWER。冬季時變身成北海道有名的滑雪、度假聖地，並以粉狀雪質而聞名全世。
resorts.notes: Hokkaido's largest single resort, spread across three peaks (West Mountain, East Mountain, Mount Isola). World-renowned for powder.

resorts.name: Kiroro Resort
resorts.description_zh: 以朝里岳為中心，位於豪雪地帶距札幌不遠的KIRORO滑雪度假村，這裡是北海道雪量跟雪質都是一絕的滑雪場。
resorts.notes: Inland resort known for exceptional snow quality. Gondola to summit with the Asari panoramic restaurant overlooking the Sea of Japan.

resorts.name: Furano Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 位於道北富良野市西側的富良野滑雪場，擁有廣大滑雪區域，兩個山頭的最高點分別為海拔1209m與940m，滑行最長距離約4000m，共有23條難易度各異的滑雪道。
resorts.notes: Operated by Prince Hotels. Two zones (Kitanomine + Furano) linked by lifts. Hosts FIS competitions; one of the steepest mountains in Hokkaido.

resorts.name: Tokachi Sahoro Resort
resorts.description_zh: 位於海拔1,059公尺的滑雪場，整個滑雪季節中的晴天率達 70%，整座山都被粉雪包裹。既有適合初、中級滑雪者而設的緩坡長距離雪道，還有最大70度的超陟滑道。
resorts.notes: Central Hokkaido. 70% sunny days through the season; views over the Tokachi plain. Family-friendly with one steep advanced run.

resorts.name: Appi Kogen Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 安比高原位於日本本州的東北部，鄰接八幡平十和田國立公園的安比高原，整座山被粉狀白雪覆蓋，擁有最高品質的積雪與標高差828公尺、最長5.5公里的滑雪道。
resorts.notes: Adjacent to Towada-Hachimantai National Park. 21 courses including a 5.5 km top-to-bottom; 2 km night skiing piste. Two gondolas, three high-speed quads.

resorts.name: Shizukuishi Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 從雪場遙望壯麗的岩手山，視野開闊是雫石高原滑雪場的一大特色。雪道變化豐富的11條滑道，從初學者到上級雪友都可以盡情享受其中，下雪過後的未壓雪滑道更是不能錯過。
resorts.notes: Prince Hotels resort with a 4.5 km World Cup downhill course. Views of Mt. Iwate; gondola to the upper station.

resorts.name: Hachimantai Panorama & Shimokura
resorts.name_ja: 八幡平リゾートパノラマ＆下倉
resorts.description_zh: 八幡平滑雪場位於日本岩手縣，以其絕佳的自然風景、多樣化的滑道和優質的雪質而聞名。
resorts.notes: Two linked resorts (Panorama + Shimokura) at the foot of Mt. Iwate inside Towada-Hachimantai National Park. Shuttles connect the two.

resorts.name: Yamagata Zao Onsen Ski Resort
resorts.name_ja: 山形蔵王温泉スキー場
resorts.description_zh: 身為Mt.6的日本老字號的滑雪場『藏王温泉』ZAO，雪量豐富時當地人俗稱的樹冰雪怪佔據整個山頭，奇景『樹冰原』由於嚴厲的冬季季風氣候所產生。
resorts.notes: Tohoku's largest ski area, famous for juhyo (snow monster) ice-encrusted trees. 14 interconnected zones across the slopes of Mt. Zao; 9 km top-to-bottom run.

resorts.name: Aomori Spring Resort
resorts.name_ja: 青森スプリンスキーリゾート
resorts.description_zh: 青森春泉滑雪場坐落於壯麗的岩木山山腳下，共5條纜車、22條雪道，包含最大傾斜角30度的高級雪道。SKI IN、SKI OUT的設計，滑完雪直接回飯店泲湯放鬆。
resorts.notes: Tohoku's northernmost major resort, at the base of Mt. Iwaki. Open-air onsen looks out over the Sea of Japan. Includes two covered high-speed quads and a gondola.

resorts.name: Onikoube Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 鬼首滑雪場分山脊部和山腳部，由雪道連接，合理的佈局適合初級到專業滑雪者自由滑雪。為極限滑雪愛好者精心設計全套專業滑道園地，還為家庭遊客提供家庭專用滑道以及托兒服務。
resorts.notes: Two-level layout (ridge + base) connected by linking trails. 7 km of slopes; family-friendly with childcare on site.

resorts.name: Inawashiro Snow Paradise
resorts.description_zh: 福島是一個日本滑雪場聚集的熱門地點。主要的滑雪場圍繞在豬苗代湖及盤梯山，除了湖光山色令人留連忘返外，豐富的温泉資源也是這裡得天獨厚的特色。
resorts.notes: On the slopes of Mt. Bandai overlooking Lake Inawashiro. Gondola + 4 hooded high-speed quads. Two contiguous ski areas with a 3.5 km top-to-bottom.

resorts.name: Hoshino Resorts Nekoma Mountain
resorts.name_ja: 星野リゾートネコママウンテン
resorts.description_zh: 貓魔山滑雪場是星野集團打造的世界級滑雪勝地，它坐落在磐梯山，根駒嶽，馬屋山三座雄偉的山峰之間。兩座雪場加總面積為993公頃、多達 33 條滑道與 13 座纜車，為東北最大的滑雪場！
resorts.notes: Re-launched in 2023/24 by Hoshino Resorts merging Alts Bandai (south) and Nekoma (north) into one pass. 993 ha across north and south slopes of Mt. Nekoma.

resorts.name: EN Resort Grandeco Snow Resort
resorts.name_ja: グランデコスノーリゾート
resorts.description_zh: Grandeco滑雪場是日本福島縣的一個知名滑雪勝地，擁有豐富的雪量、優質的粉雪及多樣化的滑道。滑雪場位於裏磐梯山腳下，周圍環繞著壯麗的自然景觀。
resorts.notes: Urabandai (north Bandai) ski area with a gondola + 3 hooded quad lifts. Ski-in / ski-out hotel; all-northern-slope orientation preserves powder.

resorts.name: Hunter Mountain Shiobara
resorts.name_ja: ハンターマウンタン塩原
resorts.description_zh: 那須高原，是日光國家公園的一部份。這裡是本州從青森縣下來的第一高山群，西伯利亞冷氣團和南方的暖氣團在此交會。
resorts.notes: Largest ski resort in the Tokyo metropolitan area; developed by the owners of New York's Hunter Mountain. 3 km flagship trail, terrain park, kids' park.

resorts.name: Hakuba Happo-One Winter Resort
resorts.name_ja: 白馬八方尾根スキー場
resorts.description_zh: 長野是日本比較罕見的內陸縣之一，被稱作日本的屋脊。這裡廣為人知的是白馬八方尾根，這個曾經舉辦過1998年冬奥運會的滑雪場，是日本知名的滑雪勝地。
resorts.notes: Hakuba Valley's largest and most central resort; hosted the 1998 Olympic alpine events. Some of the steepest piste in the valley.

resorts.name: Tsugaike Mountain Resort
resorts.description_zh: 相當受初中級者歡迎的滑雪場，適合全家同遊，超寬敞的初中級滑道佔了全體的80%，緩斜面全長14,000m，箱型纜車直達山頂。
resorts.notes: Hakuba Valley resort renowned for the widest, gentlest greens in the area. 80% beginner / intermediate; 4.6 km longest run; lift-accessed tree runs above.

resorts.name: Nozawa Onsen Snow Resort
resorts.description_zh: 飄溢著温泉香味，恬静安詳的野澤温泉村充滿了溫暖人心的魅力。以豐富的泉量而自豪的温泉，是日本Mt.6六大高山温泉滑雪区之一。
resorts.notes: MT.6 resort with an attached traditional onsen town. 50 km of trails, 10 km top-to-bottom run, two main gondolas.

resorts.name: Shiga Kogen Mountain Resort
resorts.description_zh: 長野！這個以高山風光著稱的滑雪大縣，志賀高原是為其中著名的滑雪勝地之一(1998年長野冬季奥運會滑雪的比賽主場地)。『日本六大高山滑雪度假村』(MT.6)中的三個都在長野縣。
resorts.notes: Japan's largest interconnected ski area: 18 sub-resorts, ~50 interconnected lifts, 80+ km of trails. Hosted 1998 Olympic giant slalom.

resorts.name: Ryuoo Ski Park
resorts.description_zh: 搭乘著SKYLAND EXPRESS箱型纜車上山，從山頂一覽北信濃的美麗山景，雪場有超過一半的初中級滑道，讓初學者在學習上沒有壓力。
resorts.notes: 166-passenger Skyland Express ropeway to the SORA Terrace at 1,770 m. Famous Kiotoshi advanced course at 36°.

resorts.name: Shirakaba Resort Ikenotaira Snow Park
resorts.name_ja: 白樺リゾート池の平スノーパーク
resorts.description_zh: 白樺高原位處號稱「日本小瑞士」的地帶。海拔超過 1400m, 加上高品質的粉雪, 白樺高原在日本也受到許多滑雪客的稱許。
resorts.notes: Family resort attached to Ikenotaira Hotel. High sunshine rate (~80%). Beginner-friendly with strong ski-school presence.

resorts.name: Kijimadaira Snow Resort (Romance no Kamisama)
resorts.description_zh: 木島平滑雪場位於長野縣，信州是自古至今長野縣的別稱。木島平全區有7條纜車，10條滑道。最長滑走距離可達 3公里。
resorts.notes: Rebranded as 'Snow Resort Romance no Kamisama' for 2023/24. Quiet, beginner-friendly Iiyama-area resort.

resorts.name: Karuizawa Prince Snow Resort
resorts.name_ja: 軽井沢プリンスホテルスキー場
resorts.description_zh: 由王子飯店集團所屬的軽井澤王子飯店滑雪場，海拔1155m，從山頂仰視軽井澤街道美不勝收，號稱90%晴天率的軽井澤讓你盡情享受滑雪的藍天美景。軽井澤雪場旁邊即是新幹線車站。
resorts.notes: 10-minute walk from Karuizawa Shinkansen station; one of the easiest ski resorts to reach from Tokyo. 90% sunny days, heavy snowmaking, beginner-leaning.

resorts.name: Madarao Mountain Resort
resorts.description_zh: 斑尾高原位於長野縣北面，介於野澤温泉滑雪場及妙高高原滑雪場之間。斑尾高原滑雪場中60%為非壓雪雪道，可盡情享受粉雪。斑尾高原滑雪場與斑尾東急滑雪場相連。
resorts.notes: Japan's first tree-skiing-focused resort: 10 official glades, 60% ungroomed. Connected via pass with neighbouring Tangram. Famed for 'Madapow'.

resorts.name: Sugadaira Kogen Snow Resort
resorts.name_ja: 菅平高原スノーリゾート
resorts.description_zh: 菅平高原滑雪場坐落在海拔2,207m的根子岳山腳下的高原上，是一個被壯觀的山景和美麗的自然環境所包圍的地方。它因為有著和瑞士的達沃斯一樣的景色，而被稱為「日本達沃斯」。
resorts.notes: Three linked zones (Pine Beak, Taro, Davos). 60 courses across 175 ha; nicknamed 'Davos of Japan' for its high-altitude setting.

resorts.name: Naeba Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 越後湯澤全區共有多達 19 座滑雪場，其中佔地面積最廣、最具人氣指標的就首推苗場滑雪場。『雪鄉』的新潟縣，下雪天數超過全季的50％，平均雪量達 2 公尺以上。
resorts.notes: Yuzawa-area flagship. Connected to neighbouring Kagura by the 5.5 km Dragondola (Japan's longest gondola). ~2.5 M annual skier visits.

resorts.name: Joetsu Kokusai Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 上越雪場佔地1000萬平方米，配置有25條基本道和22條變化豐富的雪道，日本屈指可數的大滑雪場之一。本雪場也是日本滑板玩家口中，相當熱門的地點。
resorts.notes: 1,000 ha terrain split into 4 zones (Mother's, Panorama, Active, Forest). Niigata-style heavy snow; popular with snowboarders.

resorts.name: Akakura Onsen Ski Resort
resorts.name_zh: 妙高高原 / 赤倉温泉
resorts.description_zh: 「赤倉温泉滑雪場」位於妙高山是日本古温泉且是日本Mt.6高山六大温泉滑雪區之一。鬆軟的天然雪況和22條豐富多彩的路線，讓你盡情暢遊在妙高温泉滑雪場！
resorts.notes: Largest Myoko Kogen ski area; operating since 1937. Three sections (Yodel, Kumado, Ginrei). Night skiing available. Linked-pass with neighbouring Akakura Kanko.

resorts.name: Maiko Snow Resort
resorts.description_zh: 舞子滑雪場位於新潟縣南魚沼市，是四季皆宜的度假勝地。雪場共3大區域，擁有全長約6,000公尺的滑道，總共有26條滑雪道。ski-in、ski-out的設計非常的方便。
resorts.notes: Three connected zones (Maiko / Nagamine / Okusoechi). 6 km top-to-bottom. Free shuttle from Echigo-Yuzawa Shinkansen station.

resorts.name: Kusatsu Onsen Ski Resort
resorts.address: 158 Forest Section, Shirane National Forest, Kusatsu-machi, Agatsuma-gun, Gunma 377-1711
resorts.description_zh: 草津温泉距今已有1000年以上的歷史。尤其以號稱治病健體的著名温泉而遠近聞名。由於年平均溫度只有7度，櫃花開得晚，4月底之前，整個草津都仍處於白雪皓皓的世界。
resorts.notes: On Mt. Shirane above the historic Kusatsu onsen town. 4.3 km longest run; new 8-seater Pulse Gondola from 2023/24. Higher base elevation than most Gunma resorts.

resorts.name: White World Oze Iwakura
resorts.name_ja: ホワイトワールド尾瀬岩鞈
resorts.description_zh: 日本關東最大規模的滑雪場 尾瀬岩鞍，這裡不但雪質優良、雪場規模大，雪道更是變化豐富，適合各種程度的滑雪客前來拜訪。
resorts.notes: Largest ski area in Kanto region. Gondola plus 9 lifts; 18 courses span beginner cruisers to ungroomed advanced terrain.

resorts.name: Manza Onsen Ski Resort
resorts.description_zh: 萬座温泉位於白根山與萬座山之間的山麓，於綠色環抱的上信越高原國立公園內，泉質屬於乳白色帶硫磺味的優質温泉，由於是標高1800m的高山温泉，又稱為雲上的温泉。
resorts.notes: Highest-base resort in Gunma (1,800 m). Operated by Prince Hotels; small but light powder thanks to elevation. Sulphurous milky onsen on site.

resorts.name: Ski Jam Katsuyama
resorts.description_zh: 日本關西規模最大滑雪場，有多條雪道可滿足不同級別滑雪者的需求，初學者到資深滑雪者都有適合的滑道。雪場也提供小朋友遊玩的兒童樂園。
resorts.notes: Western Japan's largest ski area, operated by Tokyu Resort Group. Longest run 5.8 km. About 3 h from Osaka.

resorts.name: Takasu Mountains (Takasu Snow Park, Dynaland, WhitePIA, Hirugano Kogen, Washigatake, Gujo Vacance-mura)
resorts.name_ja: 鷲タカスマウンテンズ
resorts.description_zh: 高鷲山是西日本最大的滑雪勝地之一！TAKASU MOUNTAINS由岐阜縣上市高鷲町的6個滑雪場（WhitePIA、鷲之岳滑雪場、高鷲滑雪場、Dynaland、晝野高原滑雪場、郡上Vacance Mura滑雪場）組成。
resorts.notes: Six-resort cluster on a joint lift pass (Takasu Snow Park, Dynaland, WhitePIA, Hirugano Kogen, Washigatake, Gujo Vacance-mura). ~2 h from Nagoya. Dynaland night skiing runs late.
